name: Unlock VIP (methods)

description: Forces the four pure-Java VIP wrapper methods (l/ܽۜ.᩷ۢ᩶, l/ᩴ᩶.۫ۨۢ, l/᩵᩶.۠֫ۧ, l/᩸ۗ.᩹֡۫) to return true — splice-safe (no native methods touched).
name: Unlock VIP (wrappers)

description: Removes Ekşi Sözlük ad placements and disables ad loading.
name: Hide ads

description: Opens external web links in the default browser instead of a Chrome Custom Tab.
name: Open external links in browser

description: Unlocks all premium features.
name: Unlock Premium

description: Revives the Bunny Discord client mod without Xposed or LSPosed.
name: Bunny

description: Pins playlists to the top of the YouTube Music Library.
name: Pin playlists

description: Hides the annoying Daily Deal popup that shows at every launch. The deal is still in the store.
name: Hide Daily Deal popup

description: Fixes the crash at launch on current Android and targets API 25 so that Android 14 and later install the game normally. The game is 32-bit only, so the device must still run 32-bit apps.
name: Modern Android compatibility

description: Plays the intro video on the first launch after installing, and skips it after that.
name: Play intro once

description: Removes permissions the game no longer needs, such as phone and accounts, along with the dead services that needed them.
name: Remove unused permissions

description: Makes the menus, text and pictures full size on screens above 720p, where they are otherwise small. Menus are drawn at 720p and stretched to the screen, so they look slightly blurry. The 3D gameplay keeps the screen's own resolution and stays sharp.
name: Render at 720p

description: Removes the stutter while firing, caused by the game building a new audio player for every sound.
name: Smooth sound

description: Removes the 30 second wait on the loading screen and the daily offline message, and stops the game from contacting Tapjoy, OpenFeint and Glu's dead servers.
name: Stop requests to dead servers

description: A fresh install starts with 999,999,999 Glu credits and 999,999,999 Cash. If you install the patched app as an update, your current balance stays as it is.
name: Unlimited currency

description: Forces a higher display density for this app only, so the whole UI scales up without changing the system density. Intended for low-dpi devices such as Meta Portal (160 dpi).
name: Custom DPI

options.description: Forced display density in dots-per-inch for this app only. 160 = system default (mdpi), 240 is roughly 1.5x larger. Range 96-640.
options.title: Custom DPI

description: Overrides the app versionName so a re-patched build of the same upstream version is recognised as a new version. Lets patch-only changes propagate as updates even when the upstream YouTube/YT Music version is unchanged.
name: Custom version name

options.description: Full value written to android:versionName, e.g. "20.51.39+1781904670". Use a monotonic numeric suffix so newer builds compare greater.
options.title: Version name

description: Removes the morphe experimental-version warning dialog, which otherwise nags on every re-patched build whose version differs from the recommended one.
name: Disable experimental notice

name: Disable scan counter

name: Increase scan limit

description: Always shows the publish date in video author information. Thanks to lyyako for the original implementation.
name: Always show publish date

description: Exposes TikTok's native full comment-sort sheet, including its hot, time, media, and creator modes, instead of relying on rollout gates.
name: Comment sort controls

description: Copies only the comment text without including the creator's username.
name: Copy comments without username

description: Adds a custom entry to TikTok's offline videos menu with a configurable limit from 1 to 1000 videos.
name: Custom offline videos limit

description: Adds diagnostic logging, crash capture, reports, and an optional rolling feed debugger.
name: Diagnostic tools

description: Removes TikTok's mandatory login gate from supported flows.
name: Disable login requirement

description: Keeps long-pressing Share from opening TikTok's quick-share interaction.
name: Disable long-press quick share

description: Keeps holding Like from opening TikTok's repost action.
name: Disable long-press repost

description: Disables capture detection and secure-window screenshot protection, including Circle to Search blocking.
name: Disable screen capture detection

description: Adds watermark-free downloads, video quality selection, comment sticker saving, configurable folders, and filename templates.

description: Shows TikTok's search entry in the Live drawer where supported.
name: Enable Live search

description: Uses TikTok's non-personalized search mode instead of its saved account choice.
name: Enable non-personalized search

description: Enables TikTok's native voice-comment recording and publishing entry points.
name: Enable voice comments

description: Adds a menu for viewing and overriding supported TikTok feature flags and configuration values.
name: Feature Gate Lab

description: Hides feed ads, TikTok Shop items, livestreams, stories, photo posts, and videos outside configured view or like ranges.
name: Feed filter

description: Controls which loaded top and bottom navigation tabs remain visible, blocks newly added tabs when requested, and can hide the Tako AI bubble.
name: Feed tab navigation

description: Restores Google account sign-in after patching.
name: Fix Google login

description: Forces TikTok's tablet-style split layout (video beside comments instead of a bottom sheet) once the screen is at least as wide as a configurable threshold, for foldables TikTok doesn't already recognize as tablet-class.
name: Foldable split comment view

description: Adds a setting that bypasses TikTok's rollout gates for its native Auto scroll action on supported videos.
name: Force show Auto scroll

description: Hides posts marked as AI-generated or AI-modified by TikTok or their creators. Unmarked AI content may still appear.
name: Hide AI content

description: Adds a default-off setting to hide browsing and LIVE puzzle dialogs while preserving login and account verification.
name: Hide CAPTCHA popups

description: Adds an option to hide the + follow button below creator avatars in video feeds.
name: Hide feed follow button

description: Adds an option to hide the LIVE button at the top left of video feeds.
name: Hide feed LIVE button

description: Adds an option to hide the save/favourites button from video feeds.
name: Hide feed save button

description: Adds an option to hide the search button at the top right of video feeds.
name: Hide feed search button

description: Removes floating promotional badges, coin icons, and timer banners from the Home feed.
name: Hide floating promotions

description: Hides certain batches of unpersonalized slop posts that appear in your For You feed.
name: Hide FYP unpersonalized slop videos

description: Hides TikTok's exposed quick emoji row in supported comment inputs.
name: Hide quick comment reactions

description: Removes suggested-account cards from profile and inbox surfaces. Thanks to tymmesyde for the original implementation.
name: Hide suggested accounts

description: Enables TikTok's native hold, slide down, and release gesture to lock 2x speed.
name: Hold-and-slide 2x lock

description: Opens profile and story website links in the system browser instead of TikTok's in-app browser. Thanks to lyyako for the original implementation.
name: Open external links directly

description: Enables playback-speed controls for all videos and remembers the selected speed between videos.
name: Playback speed

description: Adds in-app controls for changing the region TikTok reads.
name: Region spoof

description: Remembers TikTok's clear-display state between videos.
name: Remember clear display

description: Continues supported videos from where playback stopped when returning after a scroll.
name: Resume videos after scrolling

description: Removes tracking parameters from TikTok links before they are shared.
name: Sanitize sharing links

description: Adds the Metra patches settings menu to TikTok. Supports TikTok 46.2.3.
name: Settings

description: Adds toggles and allow-lists for the video share sheet's "Send to", "Share via app", and "Video Actions" sections.
name: Share sheet modification

description: Shows TikTok's native video seekbar where it would normally be hidden.
name: Show seekbar

description: Shows TikTok's video preview thumbnail while dragging the seekbar.
name: Show seekbar thumbnail

description: Stops videos at the end instead of replaying them.
name: Stop video looping

description: Adds comment translation controls using TikTok's translation system, with selectable language exclusions.
name: Translate comments

description: Raises how many icons Gboard's toolbar can hold — five on a stock build — to 12, so Flexboard's hotkeys and text action buttons fit alongside Gboard's own. How many actually show stays yours, set by dragging them in Gboard's toolbar settings. Force-stop Gboard afterwards: a cached keyboard view can go on showing the old capacity.
name: Bigger Toolbar

description: Bypass Gboard's signature whitelist checks and force them to pass.
name: Bypass Gboard Signature

description: Exposes Google Rambler — Gboard's agentic dictation, which rewrites what you say into composed text — as a choice in Voice settings. It is not switched on for you: the feature uses a Google server, has its own quota and asks for consent, so picking it is left to you.
name: Enable Rambler

description: Turns on two finished Gboard features that a resigned build can never receive: grammar check, and a close control on the chips Gboard offers unprompted. Their flags are delivered per app signature, so resigning the APK means they never arrive and stay off. Both are confirmed working on a device; five other flags were tried and dropped.
name: Hidden Features

description: Turns on four finished Gboard features that a resigned build can never receive: Emoji Kitchen browse, the custom sticker tab, offline translation, and search in Gboard's settings. Off by default because none of the four has been seen working on a device — the flags flip, but each also depends on data Google only sends to an unpatched install. Safe to try: none of them crashes.
name: Hidden Features (unconfirmed)

description: Rename the package to dev.jz6.com.google.android.inputmethod.latin so the patched build installs alongside the official Gboard instead of replacing it.
name: Install as Gboard Clone

description: Uses Android's haptic primitives for keypresses — the crisp tick the rest of the system uses — instead of a plain buzz. Gboard has the code and disables it with an impossible minimum Android version; this removes that. Devices whose vibrator cannot do primitives are unaffected, because Gboard's own hardware check still runs. Note that it changes what the vibration strength slider means, from milliseconds to intensity.
name: Modern keypress haptics

description: Turns on flick keys for symbols, touch & hold keys for numbers, suggestion strip, grammar check and smart replies, and turns off block offensive words and word suggestions. Written once as defaults, so each can still be changed in Gboard's own settings. Grammar check is the switch, not the feature: the row only exists on a resigned build if Hidden Features is applied too.
name: Suggested Settings

description: Swipe left anywhere on the keyboard to delete the previous word, and swipe right to restore it. Uses Gboard's own word-scrub engine, so it behaves exactly like swiping on the backspace key already does — only it can start anywhere.
name: Swipe Left to Delete
